## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain what heritability (h²) measures, and why a trait
  needs it to respond to selection (the breeder's equation, R = h²S)
- Understand experimental evolution studies and interpret scientific figures and results
- Explain why sometimes selection can fail to change a
  trait



::: {.notes}
 low heritability vs. an unfavorable correlation/trade-off
  with another trait
Connect short-generation experimental evolution (pollinator-driven
  selection) to what heritability predicts should (or shouldn't) happen

- Understand what heritability of floral volatiles and the genetic architecture (G-matrix) with other traits reveal about
  the microevolutionary potential of plant traits
:::
